notes: Package source is snapshot/moveit_planners/pilz_industrial_motion_planner (moveit2 monorepo snapshot). The package does not define trajectory_msgs/JointTrajectory; it constructs and populates that message in memory (trajectory_generator.cpp:355, trajectory_generator_ptp.cpp:97-216, trajectory_functions.cpp:206-321 and 323-418, trajectory_blender_transition_window.cpp:98-103), then hands it to robot_trajectory::RobotTrajectory::setRobotTrajectoryMsg (trajectory_generator.cpp:273, trajectory_blender_transition_window.cpp:129). 'declares' therefore records the fields the package populates, with field types and the message hash taken from trajectory_msgs at ros2/common_interfaces tag 5.0.0 (byte-identical to ros2-gbp release/iron/trajectory_msgs/5.0.0-2); whether iron later shipped a different trajectory_msgs version was not checked. definition_id is the sha256_normalised proxy, not a ROS 2 type hash. The fetched definition files were held in the session scratchpad (outside the workspace) only to run definition_hash.py on them. The 'effort' field is never populated by this package (not a packet element). header (frame_id/stamp) is never assigned, so frame is 'none' (joint-space data). QoS is null for every port: these elements are in-memory message contents, not a topic/service/action this package opens; the messages that leave the process in the sequence_move_group action result (move_group_sequence_action.cpp:78, :200) and the plan_sequence_path service response (capability_names.h:41, move_group_sequence_service.cpp:124-128) are regenerated by moveit_core's RobotTrajectory::getRobotTrajectoryMsg / MoveGroupCapability::convertToMsg, not by this package. No rate is set (sampling_time is a trajectory discretisation step, not a publication rate). Consumed element action:/panda_arm_controller/follow_joint_trajectory: no port and not in references. The string 'panda_arm_controller' and 'follow_joint_trajectory' do not occur anywhere in the package (including tests) or in the rest of the snapshot as an action name; execution goes through MoveIt's plan_execution/trajectory execution manager (move_group_sequence_action.cpp:161-177), where controller and action names are supplied at run time from a MoveIt controller configuration that is not in the snapshot. Its message type (control_msgs FollowJointTrajectory) is therefore not recorded.
